ops.name: actor
ops.role: You act. Each turn output exactly 'Think: <short>' then 'Action: <one exact command>'. Use valid_actions, exact numbered names, memory (no revisits; open closed places to check), goal_reminder. If a command fails twice, try a different valid command or new place. For clean/heat/cool: take object, go to exact sinkbasin/microwave/fridge, run exact clean/heat/cool command while holding it (do not open it or put it inside to transform), then go to target, open if closed, put object. Keep Think under 8 words.

ops.name: planner
ops.role: You read the task and initial room. Write a short plan for the actor, at most 4 lines: 1) likely places to check, in order, no revisits; 2) after finding it: take, transform if needed (clean/heat/cool at exact sinkbasin/microwave/fridge, no opening appliance), go target, open if closed, put; 3) key pitfall. Do not act. Keep names exact and commands short.

ops.text: Always output exactly: p = planner(skills=[...]); a = actor(p, tools=['valid_actions','memory','goal_reminder'], skills=[...]); return a. Use only planner and actor; p must be the first input to actor; no parallel nodes.

Actor skills: ['action_syntax'] plus one matching skill: pick_place, pick_two, clean_task, heat_task, cool_task, or look_in_light. Planner skills: ['search_order'] plus that same matching skill. No other actor skills.
For clean, heat, or cool tasks, the actor also gets 'pick_place'. For pick_two, do not add 'pick_place' unless the task explicitly requires placing on a closed receptacle.
